tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The ground of every page and picture, under the paper-glow and paper-shade washes.

tokens.name: paper-glow
tokens.usage: The light wash over the ground, centred near its top left.

tokens.name: paper-shade
tokens.usage: The shaded wash over the ground, centred near its bottom right.

tokens.name: ticket
tokens.usage: The fill of a ticket, a slip, a code block, a button: anything set on the ground as a piece of paper. Text on stamp, as in a selection (6.0:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and every border, on paper (12.6:1) and ticket (14.2:1).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: a lede, a caption, the colophon, the subtitle of a picture; on paper (7.9:1) and ticket (8.8:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Kickers, table headings, a picture's small print; on paper (5.1:1) and ticket (5.8:1). Never body text.

tokens.name: stamp
tokens.usage: The one accent: links, a sid, a stamp, the fault marked in a rule, the key ticket of a figure; on paper (5.4:1) and ticket (6.0:1).

tokens.name: stamp-deep
tokens.usage: A link or a button under the pointer; on paper (7.8:1) and ticket (8.7:1).

tokens.name: stamp-ground
tokens.usage: The fill behind a stamp, so that a line it sits on does not show through it.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines that carry no meaning: the lines between a table's rows, a divider, the edge of a column.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The title of a page, once; 36px on a phone.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: A section of a page; 28px on a phone.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The heading of a ticket, of one half of a pair, of a figure's box.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: The specification is kept for the life of the system, and the code is held to it.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a page's title, in ink-soft.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every change runs one way: the rule first, then its test, then the code.
styles.usage: The body of an article and of every page of prose, at most measure wide.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: A rule is implemented only once its owner has confirmed its wording.
styles.usage: Text inside a ticket, a note or a table cell.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: A label above a title or on a ticket, set in capitals by the stylesheet, in ink-faint.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: The git hooks run them on every machine, whoever commits.
styles.usage: A caption, the navigation, the colophon.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, a command, a path, a sid.

styles.name: stamp-word
styles.usage: The word of a stamp, in stamp.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The gap inside a stamp.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its text, between list items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a heading and the paragraph under it.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs; a ticket's padding top and bottom; the least side gutter of a page.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: A ticket's padding at the sides; between the items of a navigation.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between the halves of a pair; a slip's padding at the sides.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Above a heading inside prose; between the sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: A frame's padding; the space above a page's title.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Tickets, slips, frames, code blocks, buttons: square, as paper is cut.

tokens.name: radius-stamp
tokens.usage: A rubber stamp's corners.

tokens.name: radius-ring
tokens.usage: The ring drawn round a word marked in a rule.

border.note: Widths; the style of each is in the component that draws it.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: The rule colour's hairlines; the red margin rule.

tokens.name: border-line
tokens.usage: A slip, a code block, a figure's edge, a note (dashed), the focus ring.

tokens.name: border-stamp
tokens.usage: A stamp's line and the ring round a marked word.

tokens.name: border-ticket
tokens.usage: A ticket, a button and the seal, drawn double.

tokens.name: border-frame
tokens.usage: The frame round a whole card, drawn double.

angle.note: A stamp is never set straight.

tokens.name: tilt-stamp
tokens.usage: A stamp: REFUSED, CHECKED, the fault named on a slip.

tokens.name: tilt-seal
tokens.usage: The seal: MERGED, COMMITTED, a verdict that closes a flow.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The widest a column of prose runs.

tokens.name: page-width
tokens.usage: The widest a page's content runs, the masthead and the colophon included.
